title: Reward path dead — HandleQuestCompleted never subscribed, quest.reward.distributed has zero consumers
description:
Two bugs:

1. router_client.go:101-109 registers only meta_db.quest.get/set, player.joined/left, inventory topics. There is NO quest.completed subscription, so HandleQuestCompleted() never runs → rewards never persisted.

2. QuestManager::distributeRewards() publishes to quest.reward.distributed topic (QuestManager.cpp:289) — zero consumers exist for this topic.

**Files**: src/services/meta_db/router_client.go, reward_handlers.go
**Impact**: Quest completion rewards are never stored or delivered.
close_reason: Closed

title: QuestManager orphaned — never instantiated, link error
description:
QuestManager.h/cpp exist but nothing instantiates it — no refs in simcore main, CraftRequestHandler, or block-place pipeline. Crafting/placing blocks never triggers quest logic.

Additionally, publishQuestCompleted() / publishQuestProgressUpdated() are declared in QuestManager.h:34-36 and called from QuestManager.cpp but never defined → link error.

**Files**: src/services/simulation_core/Quest/QuestManager.h, QuestManager.cpp
**Impact**: Quest detection is dead code. Simcored won't link.
close_reason: Closed

title: Crafting table opens MachineWindow (flat row) instead of 3x3 CraftingWindow
description: Why: crafting_table (0:10:11:1=22529) is listed in machines.yaml, so BlockUIFactory::LoadFromRegistry registered it -> MachineWindow (Render draws input slots in one row via SameLine). CraftingWindow was only registered under flat legacy id 14. What: override 0:10:11:1 -> CraftingWindow in BlockUIFactory static registry; LoadFromRegistry skips already-registered ids.
close_reason: Fixed: BlockUIFactory overrides crafting_table 0:10:11:1 -> CraftingWindow; LoadFromRegistry keeps manual registrations. Client rebuilt, 8/8 tests pass.

title: Server crafting matches wrong recipe (aggregate vs positional 3x3)
description: Why: client MatchGrid is positional (3x3 pattern) but server Recipe::matches is aggregate count (requires a single slot with count>=req). Result: any grid with >=1 oak_plank matches the crafting_table recipe, so crafting a pickaxe/stick/furnace produces a crafting_table and consumes 1 item. Verified in test_recipe_manager_craft_patterns. What: add positional pattern support to RecipeManager and encode 13 crafting_table patterns in yaml.
close_reason: Closed

title: Heat generator burns fuel but produces no energy
description: Why: machines.yaml heat_generator (1110:00:2) has no capacity field; MachineRegistry defaults capacity to 0. SimulationEngine creates EnergyStorage(0,...) and GeneratorSystem's isFull() (current>=capacity → 0>=0) returns true, so the generator skips every tick before burning fuel. What: add capacity to producer machines in machines.yaml.
close_reason: Closed

title: Two divergent MetaDB quest implementations — different wire formats and topics
description:
Two separate MetaDB quest handler implementations exist with incompatible wire formats:

1. quest_handlers.go — FlatBuffers-based (QuestProgressUpdate FB), topics quest.get/quest.set (matches spec)
2. router_client.go:406-491 — raw binary (player_id:8 LE + entries), topics meta_db.quest.get/meta_db.quest.set (what's actually registered with router)

The spec matches #1 (FlatBuffers), but #2 (raw binary) is what's actually wired. Different response topic patterns too.

**Files**: src/services/meta_db/quest_handlers.go, router_client.go
**Impact**: Inconsistent behavior depending on which path is used. Per author decision D2 — deferred, not blocking
notes: Fixed: unified quest wire format to FlatBuffers QuestProgressUpdate. Changes: (1) router_client.go dispatch meta_db.quest.get/.set -> HandleQuestGet/HandleQuestSet (FB), removed raw binary handleQuestGet/handleQuestSet + dead meta_db.quest.progress.update publish; (2) PlayerJoinedHandler.cpp publishes FB QuestProgressUpdate (empty quests vector = query) instead of raw 8-byte player_id; (3) QuestManager::loadProgress parses FB QuestProgressUpdate with verifier (was raw binary); (4) SimCoreMessageHandler reads player_id via FB verifier (was raw memcpy, potential OOB); (5) added quest_wire_test.go Go unit test for FB wire contract. Build: ninja clean, 3 pre-existing test failures unchanged (simcored energy gen, pipe_network fluid, item_registry segfault). Go tests pass.
close_reason: Closed

title: No progress restore on player join — persistence is write-only

**Files**: src/services/simulation_core/Quest/QuestManager.cpp:10-33
**Impact**: Quest progress lost on reconnect. Player must re-complete all quests every session.
close_reason: Closed

title: quest.completed carries 3 incompatible payloads on one topic
description:
Three different payload formats land on quest.completed topic:
1. QuestManager publishes QuestCompleted FlatBuffer (SimCore → internal)
2. MetaDB HandleQuestSet fabricates QuestCompleted event via FlatBuffers (quest_handlers.go:116-118)
3. router_client.go:481 publishes raw 12-byte binary blob

All forwarded to client as GatewayMsg 21. Schema mismatch on the wire, duplicate delivery.

**Fix**: Split topics per author decision D3 — quest.completed (SimCore→MetaDB internal only), quest.completed.notification (MetaDB→Gateway→Client).

**Files**: src/services/meta_db/quest_handlers.go, router_client.go, src/services/gateway/gateway.cpp:410
close_reason: Closed

title: detect_target ids don't match items.csv registry — all 38 targets invalid
description:
quests.csv uses plain integer detect_target values (33, 4, 35, 74, …). data/registry/items.csv uses hierarchical string IDs (0:11110:3, 0:110:1, 1111:00:0). The uint16 itemId model in checkCraftCompletion collides with a string-ID registry.

Additionally, QuestData::LoadCSV() parses detect_target as std::string, but QuestManager::checkCraftCompletion() uses std::to_string(itemId) (uint16 → string). This double-mismatch means every single detect_target lookup fails.

**Files**: data/quests/quests.csv, data/registry/items.csv, src/libs/quest_lib/QuestData.cpp, src/services/simulation_core/Quest/QuestManager.cpp:42
**Impact**: Zero quests can be auto-completed via craft detection.
close_reason: Closed

title: GetQuestDefinition stub causes nil-pointer panic for quest != 1
description:
GetQuestDefinition() (reward_handlers.go:244-258) returns hardcoded data for quest ID 1 only, nil for all others. HandleQuestCompleted() (quest_handlers.go:188) unconditionally dereferences questDef.Era/questDef.Section → nil-pointer panic for any quest ≠ 1.

**Files**: src/services/meta_db/reward_handlers.go:244-258, quest_handlers.go:188
**Impact**: Once quest.completed flow is wired, any non-quest-1 completion crashes MetaDB.
close_reason: Closed

title: Client OnNetworkUpdate OOB-read, ignores msg 20/21, hardcoded constants
description:
QuestBookWindow::OnNetworkUpdate() (QuestBookWindow.cpp:217-224):
1. Handles only msgType 19, never processes 20 (QuestUnlockNotification) or 21 (QuestCompletedNotification)
2. Copies 1024 bytes regardless of actual payload size — OOB read risk at line 221
3. Hardcoded msgType 19 instead of GatewayMsg enum
4. updateQuestStatus() uses raw binary parsing (lines 200-215) instead of FlatBuffers deserialization

**Files**: src/services/game_client/UI/Windows/player/QuestBookWindow.cpp:200-224
**Impact**: Unlock/completion notifications never displayed. Potential crash on small payloads.
close_reason: Client quest wire fixed: (1) GameClient registers SetQuestUpdateCallback so msg 20/21/22 reach UIManager (previously dropped); (2) QuestBookWindow::OnNetworkUpdate now handles kQuestProgressUpdate/kQuestUnlockNotification/kQuestCompletedNotification via GatewayMsg enum (no hardcoded 19); (3) replaced raw 1024-byte memcpy (OOB read) + raw binary parsing with FlatBuffers verifier + GetRoot; (4) applyQuestStatus helper. Verified: build clean, standalone wire-contract QA 15/15 checks pass, no new ctest failures (3 pre-existing tracked separately).

title: P2 Questbook icons + lock-reasons + auto_complete + machine detection
description:
Implement OpenSpec change `add-questbook-icons-lock-reasons` (questbook capability).

## Scope
4 workstreams + user expansion:

1. **Data**: `data/quests/quest_rewards.json` (rewards XOR choice_of; entry type item/experience/special) + `data/quests/quest_requirements.json` (per-quest `auto_complete` default true + requirements array; kinds craft/obtain/place/machine/side_configured). Seed all 163 quests.
2. **quest_lib (C++)**: `QuestRewards::LoadJSON` + `QuestRequirements::LoadJSON`; extend `QuestDef` with `autoComplete` + `machine` requirement fields; lock-reason helper.
3. **MetaDB (Go)**: swap CSV reward/requirement lookup for JSON (definitions.go / loadQuestDefinitions); CSV normalized to 13 cols preserving WIP reorder of quests 27/28/36.
4. **Client**: QuestBookWindow requirement/reward icon rows (TextureAtlas GetItemUV + GetName), lock-reason panel, choice UI, hide Complete per auto_complete; add prerequisites to QuestEntry.
5. **Server (SimulationCore)**: `auto_complete` gating in 5 detection handlers (false → AVAILABLE not COMPLETED); `checkMachineOutput` on machine output-slot take path (MachineSlotHandler) + INVENTORY-style fallback.

## Decisions
- `choice_of` (pick 1 of N) supports ALL reward types (mixed item/experience/special).
- `auto_complete` default true; all 163 quests seeded true for now.
- Gating at detection-handler level (not inside completeQuestInternal).
- machine match via `ItemId::idToHierarchical(machineId)` where machineId == machine block_id.

## Deliverables
- All tests passing (ctest in cmake-build-debug).
- design.md/tasks.md/spec delta updated to match expanded scope.
- Committed + pushed (session close protocol).

title: Re-scope unify-recipe-ids to parser format-detect only
description:
## Why

unify-recipe-ids as written assumed flat recipe ids == packed ItemIds, but they are legacy block ids (35/43 ids absent from items.csv). Mechanical ItemId::unpack() migration would corrupt every recipe. Re-scope to parser-only format-detect; data migration to string names owned by fix-ore-processing-chain.

## What

1. Rewrite openspec/changes/unify-recipe-ids (proposal.md, tasks.md, spec delta): drop broken migration script, drop 'Migration to Hierarchical Preferred' requirement.
2. Implement RecipeManager::resolveItemId format-detect in parseYamlInputItem/parseYamlOutputItem: contains ':' -> ItemId::pack (hierarchical); all digits -> ItemId::pack (flat); else -> resolveItemName.
3. Verify: openspec validate, build, ctest.
close_reason: Re-scoped to parser-only: resolveItemId format-detect implemented, migration script removed (flat recipe ids are legacy block ids — mechanical unpack() would corrupt data). Build + all 8 ctest suites pass, openspec validates.

title: QuestGraph needs all-quests-seeded-LOCKED invariant for correct DAG evaluation
description:
QuestGraph::NewlyAvailable()/GetUnlocked()/IsEraComplete() iterate the current progress map and only see entries present in it. Nothing pre-seeds every quest as LOCKED per player, so:
- NewlyAvailable() returns nothing (no LOCKED entries to check)
- IsEraComplete() returns true prematurely (skips never-touched quests — they're not in the map)

**Fix**: onPlayerJoined() must seed every quest from QuestData as LOCKED in the progress map.

**Files**: src/libs/quest_lib/QuestGraph.cpp:26-64, src/services/simulation_core/Quest/QuestManager.cpp:10-33
close_reason: Closed

title: quest.get.response never reaches client — Gateway has no subscription
description:
Gateway subscribes to quest.completed, quest.unlocked, quest.progress.updated (gateway/main.cpp:128-130). But NOT to quest.get.response (or meta_db.quest.get.response). When MetaDB responds to a quest.get request, the response is published but Gateway doesn't forward it to the client.

**Files**: src/services/gateway/main.cpp:128-130
**Impact**: Client cannot load quest progress from MetaDB on startup. OnNetworkUpdate never fires for initial state.
close_reason: Added gateway.subscribe('meta_db.quest.get.response') + routing in on_router_publish to forward as kQuestProgressUpdate. Client already handles this message type. Build + all 8 tests pass.

title: Multiple boilers feeding one steam network: aggregate capacity
description: When several boilers publish STEAM node updates for the same network, aggregate their capacity/production correctly. No aggregation logic seen today. Part of implement-heat-management task 3.1.
close_reason: Root cause: STEAM (EnergyType=2) had no routing in handleNodeUpdate() — fell through to nothing. Fixed by routing STEAM to setNodeHeat() alongside HEAT. Multiple boilers on same network now naturally aggregate via distributeHeat() tick. Resolves the 'no aggregation' symptom.
